content:
chore: adaptations for nightly-2026-09-15 nightly#299

Please review this PR. At the next toolchain release this diff will land in 'master'.

I don't think we should merge this PR without knowing which nightly will become the next Lean release candidate: if it is indeed 2026-09-14 then nightly#298 should be fixed and merged first. And there are strange changes to the lakefile in this PR.
The adaptations in the actual Lean files look fine to me, by the way, it is more about making sure we're using the rest of the infrastructure correctly.
What do you mean by "next"? If you mean v4.35.0-rc1, that one is already tagged, and it is 2026-09-14.
cc @Kim Morrison, and see Anne's comment on nightly#298

v4.35.0-rc1 has been released and it is based on nightly-2026-09-14. Since nightly#298 contains no real changes (it only changes the toolchain and manifest, both of which will be overwritten on the bump branch anyways), I didn't wait for it to be merged before the release. I did fix the one warning by adding a +typeChanged, like here. The PR can safely be closed; Kim's comment is right.

However, the rc1 should have been based on 2026-09-15, so I'm releasing an rc2 based on 2026-09-15 immedately after the rc1. The adaptations from nightly#299 will need to become part of the bump PR to v4.35.0-rc2. The easiest way for this to happen is to merge them into the bump/4.36.0 branch as usual, and I'll merge that branch back into my v4.35.0-rc2 bump PR.
I've done roughly that in #43874 by including all the nightly-testing changes from before the nightly-2026-09-16 toolchain bump
Not labeling as auto-merge-after-CI since those changes haven't been reviewed yet
cc @Anne Baanen and @Kim Morrison
Thanks for the bump PR, since the changes in nightly#299 already look good to me, and #43874 does essentially the same, let's get it merged! :tada:
